Dim wsdoc, enabled, disabled
Set wsdoc = Application.Manager.GetWorkspaceByIndex(0)
enabled = CByte(1)
disabled = CByte(0)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcHarmonics", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcIntermods", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("ShowTotals", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CoherentIM", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("AutoRecalc", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcNoise", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcPhaseNoise", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("UseSourcePts", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.MaxOrder.Set("3")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.Path0.PathFreq.Set("1000")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.ChanBW.Set("1")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.UseVolterra.Set("0")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.UseWithin.Set("-50")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.G.Set("10")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.NF.Set("3")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.OP1dB.Set("20")

Dim wsdoc, enabled, disabled
Set wsdoc = Application.Manager.GetWorkspaceByIndex(0)
enabled = CByte(1)
disabled = CByte(0)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcHarmonics", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcIntermods", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("ShowTotals", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CoherentIM", enabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("AutoRecalc", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcNoise", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("CalcPhaseNoise", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.SetProperty("UseSourcePts", disabled)
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.MaxOrder.Set("3")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.Path0.PathFreq.Set("1000")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.ChanBW.Set("1E-06")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.UseVolterra.Set("0")
Call wsdoc.Designs.System3.UseWithin.Set("-50")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.G.Set("10")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.NF.Set("3")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.OP1dB.Set("20")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.OPSAT.Set("23")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.OIP2.Set("40")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.OIP3.Set("30")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.Zref.Set("50")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.ZIN.Set("50")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.ZOUT.Set("50")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.RISO.Set("100")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.PortParamType.Set("0")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.AMtoPM_Mode.Set("0")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.EnablePN.Set("0")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp1.ParamSet.FrequencyMode.Set("0")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp2.ParamSet.G.Set("10")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp2.ParamSet.NF.Set("3")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp2.ParamSet.OP1dB.Set("20")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp2.ParamSet.OPSAT.Set("23")
Call wsdoc.Designs.Design3.PartList.RFAmp2.ParamSet.OIP2.Set("40")
